summary: Dr. Mehta hosted a kickoff meeting for the Student Portal Project with Rahul, Priya, and Ankit. Rahul committed to delivering the frontend by Friday and sending the API list to Priya tomorrow, while database completion timelines remain to be set. The group established technology and hosting choices as well as a recurring meeting schedule, though documentation and testing tasks remain unassigned.
